categories.main_business_segments: Range Intelligent Computing Technology Group primarily operates in the integrated computing power center sector, focusing on IDC (Internet Data Center) and AIDC (Artificial Intelligence Data Center) businesses. The company invests in, constructs, owns, and operates high-grade, efficient, and green computing power centers across multiple regions in China, providing hosting, management, and intelligent computing services to internet, cloud, and AI customers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including liquid cooling systems for high-density computing, AI-driven intelligent operation and maintenance platforms, and green energy solutions to enhance energy efficiency. It employs a 'self-invest, self-build, self-hold, self-operate' model, integrating cutting-edge AI, cloud computing, and data center management technologies to deliver scalable and sustainable computing infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading internet companies, cloud service providers, AI enterprises, and certain government ministries. The company serves high-demand sectors requiring large-scale, reliable, and secure data center services, focusing on AI training, inference, and application workloads, as well as traditional internet and cloud hosting needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: Range Technology has established computing power center clusters in six major regions across China: Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei (Langfang), Yangtze River Delta (Pinghu), Greater Bay Area (Foshan and Huizhou), Chengdu-Chongqing economic zone, Northwest China (Lanzhou), and Hainan Free Trade Port (Danzhou). These locations form a nationwide integrated computing power center network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the investment, construction, ownership, and operation of data center infrastructure. It collaborates with upstream equipment suppliers and downstream telecom operators to provide hosting and intelligent computing services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes green and low-carbon development, technological innovation in liquid cooling and AI data centers, and the expansion of intelligent operation and maintenance capabilities. R&D initiatives focus on energy efficiency, AI-driven management systems, and the integration of computing resources to support AI workloads and digital economy growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of IDC and AIDC services, including hosting fees based on cabinet usage, management services, and intelligent computing services for AI customers. The company operates primarily on a wholesale model in partnership with telecom operators, billing customers based on service contracts and usage.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Range Technology is positioned as a leading integrated computing power center provider in China, recognized for its scale, technological innovation, and green data center solutions. It competes with other major IDC and AI data center operators, leveraging its nationwide cluster layout and advanced liquid cooling technology to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.36 billion, a slight increase of 0.32% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.79 billion, up 1.62%. Total assets reached over RMB 31.3 billion, reflecting a 34.31% growth from the previous year, supported by ongoing investments in new data center projects and infrastructure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Range Technology differentiates itself through its nationwide integrated computing power center network, advanced liquid cooling technology enabling high-density and energy-efficient deployments, and a robust self-operated model ensuring stability, security, and reliability. Its deep customer trust, green low-carbon initiatives, and comprehensive AI computing ecosystem provide unique value to customers seeking scalable, efficient, and sustainable computing infrastructure.
